Title: Code-free data transformation at scale using Azure Data Factory

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory has new code-free visual data transformation capabilities. You can visually design, build, and manage data transformation processes without learning Spark or having a deep understanding of the distributed infrastructure.

For more information, watch the Channel 9 video.
